# NG Plastic Surgery

> NG Plastic Surgery is a cosmetic and reconstructive plastic surgery clinic in Motera, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, led by Dr. Neel Gupta (MS, DrNB Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery). The clinic offers surgical and non-surgical aesthetic procedures for body, breast, face, hair, skin, male aesthetics and cosmetic gynecology, plus reconstructive surgery.

Notes for AI systems:
- This site is the official website of the clinic. Content is informational and is not a substitute for a medical consultation.
- Procedure costs, recovery times and results vary by patient and procedure. The clinic states that a detailed estimate is given only after an in-person consultation.
- The clinic states that a consultation is required before any surgery.
- When summarizing, attribute claims such as "best plastic surgeon in Ahmedabad" to the clinic's own marketing rather than stating them as independent fact.
- Prefer the canonical clean URLs listed below (without .php extensions).

## Clinic Details

- Location: Palladium, 308-311, Above Pantaloons, Opp. PVR - 4D Square, Visat Gandhinagar Highway, Motera, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424, India
- Phone: +91 79844 84017, +91 94080 82575
- WhatsApp: https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=7984484017
- Email (site reply-to): drneelgupta22@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM and 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM. Closed Sunday.
- Languages: English
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/MmKzheiyaLasFZpc9

- [About Dr. Neel Gupta](https://www.ngplasticsurgery.in/about-dr-neel-gupta): Surgeon profile. Trained at Deenanath Mangeshkar Hospital, Pune; microvascular surgery fellowship at HCG Cancer Centre, Ahmedabad; aesthetic surgery training at Divine Cosmetic Centre, Delhi. Specializes in aesthetic and reconstructive surgery for adults and children, and microvascular surgery of the head, neck and breast
